summary: The change of atlas is now proved once in `SectionChartData`, and the half-plane chart lemmas are shared, which fixes the earlier duplication. What remains is new null-set lemmas and bordered wrappers with no consumers that re-derive the generic `ReadsFrom.coord_ae_eq`, plus the boundaryless versions in `Measure.lean`, which this PR leaves with no users.
